Maria: Quick vendor lane recap  Gaudi requested a 7-day firmware embargo, NVIDIA H200 mini-shipment slipped ~10d. Need a tiny triage for marketplace listing + SI staging. cc @Alex @Sunita
Alex: got it. Can we hand partners a pinned staging image so SI can proceed even if listing is withheld?
Sunita: yes, SI wants a baked image + smoke script. Prefer `redwood-node:staging-gaudi-20260505`.
Diego: lab note  we can free 8 H100s for contingency on 2026-05-06. B200 nodes live but need driver 1.4.3 to fix telemetry.
vendor-feed-bot: Vendor bulletin: Habana/Gaudi requests embargo until 2026-05-17. NVIDIA H200 tranche now ETA 2026-05-16. B200 driver 1.4.3 ETA 2026-05-06.
Priya: marketing: will prepare a holding statement and comms kit; no press until listing flips to public.
Maria: draft plan:
- Marketplace: `listing_state=withheld` for affected SKUs until compat tickets close.
- Images: build `redwood-node:staging-gaudi-20260505` with driver pins + /opt/redwood/smoke.sh.
- SI: handoff staging tag 2026-05-06.
- Lab: reserve 8 H100s for SI smoke.
Action owners: Alex build image, Diego reserve GPUs, Sunita prep smoke harness, Priya draft comms. Reply :thumbsup: if ok or call blockers.
Alex: :thumbsup: building image, ETA 05/05.
Sunita: :thumbsup: smoke harness in progress.
Diego: :thumbsup: reserving H100s.
Priya: :thumbsup: drafting comms kit.
Maria: thanks all  we'll re-open if vendor dates change.
